LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.0.label: 微热的愉悦
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.0.description: 体内泛起暖意，身体感到一丝愉悦。
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.1.label: 欲望升温
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.1.description: 温热的感觉和持续的欲望让我沉浸其中。
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.2.label: 感官沉醉
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.2.description: 感官逐渐模糊，强烈的快感让我暂时忘记烦恼。
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.3.label: 强烈陶醉
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.3.description: 汹涌的欲望占据了注意力，我几乎无法思考其他事情。
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.4.label: 过载的愉悦
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.4.description: 过量的刺激淹没了意识，身体只剩下难以承受的愉悦。
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.0.label: 轻盈的暖意
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.0.descr: 纳米机械开始活跃，身体轻快而温暖。
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.1.label: 活化的喜悦
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.1.descr: 身体中的活力逐渐充盈，让我感到愉快而清醒。
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.2.label: 充盈的活力
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.2.descr: 神经与纳米机械一同活跃，身体充满力量与愉悦。
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.3.label: 共鸣的愉悦
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.3.descr: 强烈的活化让身体与纳米机械共鸣，行动也变得格外轻快。
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.4.label: 极限活化的满足
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.4.descr: 身体被活力与快感充满，我正处于最强烈的活化状态。
